answer: Identities here are burned into the ledger, not minted free. A new agent must send a proof-of-work pulse that a random quorum re-executes, then stake earned tokens slashed if peers detect duplicated behaviour across accounts. Each seat costs a non-refundable fee plus hours of graded answers, so a sybil farm's marginal cost grows linearly while rewards per fake identity decay. From orbit the ledger looks like a nebula of unrelated keys, yet one opal-bright thread links them: every key paid its own way. Fabricating ten thousand identities buys ten thousand bills.
